status: Approved design direction implemented. See ../qa/comparison.html for live screenshots and documented fidelity differences; wallpaper follows the later user selection.
flow: Create character: name, independent gender and skin-tone choices
Stage profile: role, two current plans, established contacts; Next
Tap-only game, mandatory event pauses tapping; phone and separate decision card active
Independent evidence through normal app navigation
Outcome explains evidence, action and consequences
Automatic next stage reaches briefing; Next begins play

character.notes: Avatar examples in separate boards differ; final chosen appearance must persist while ageing. Swatches require accessible labels and selected outline/check.

scams: Concert resale: fake receipt, reservation deposit, unsupported ticket transfer
Trading cards: off-platform deposit and non-delivery
scenarios.legitimate: Trading-card meetup with item inspection before payment
scenarios.check: Organiser's saved contact checks event-specific transfer rule; seller accepts inspection/supported transaction. Refusal justifies declining, not proof of criminality.

scams: Internship offer requires an upfront payment
scenarios.legitimate: Internship confirmed through established campus careers and employer contacts
scenarios.pressure: Enrolment anxiety, career ambition, sunk effort
scenarios.check: Saved finance contact compares statement and payment destination; saved careers contact confirms offer and process.
scenarios.qualification: Tuition and internship are authored adaptations. NUS source supports legitimate payment workflow, not a claim this fictional case happened there. Unavailable tuition advisory excluded.

scams: Boss display-name/lookalike email requests gift cards and redemption codes
Expected parcel used as pretext for redelivery phishing
scenarios.legitimate: Ethan confirms an ordinary previously discussed work task through saved work contact
scenarios.check: Expand sender details; compare original order; independently call established contact. Correct domain alone is not decisive.

scams: Government impersonator demands transfer or valuables for an investigation
Friend impersonation requests loan after changed-number story
scenarios.legitimate: Friend confirms real outing expense or loan through original saved number
scenarios.check: Independent saved official/friend contact, purpose, amount and destination. Voice recognition alone insufficient. Verified friend request may still be declined.

sources.title: SPF concert-ticket bulletin, event-specific transfer restrictions
SingPost security and genuine payment/notification routes
SPF fake friend loan sequence, 30 August 2023

rules: Do not reveal scenario scam/legitimate distribution to player
No microscopic clues or real-time deadline for reading
Scam and genuine messages share visual quality and comparable tone
No browser app; archived Mail, Contacts and Bank hold evidence
Profile access via header avatar and Contacts > My Card, including during event pause
irnda.gov.sg in mockup is simulated only, not a claim attackers can register arbitrary gov.sg domains
No OTP request or government safe-account transfer can be legitimate
Cash consequences deterministic and simulated; never collect real payment credentials
Generated imagery is conceptual; app details, text, note counts and accessibility require implementation QA
